name: WSJT-X
description: Update-Hamlib button downloads libhamlib-4.dll over HTTPS and swaps it into the load path on restart, no hash/sig.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: WSJT-X stages the downloaded Hamlib DLL by rename without hash/signature verification; this is a component channel.
limitations: Newly retrieved/recovered source snapshot; this is not historical source re-verification. Released artifact behavior and external framework enforcement remain unverified.

original_evidence.text: | WSJT-X | https://github.com/WSJTX/wsjtx | Qt/C++ | Y (component updater, not app self-update) | manual (button click; no self-update check for WSJT-X itself found) | Y (downloads `libhamlib-4.dll` and stages it to replace the loaded Hamlib DLL on next restart) | https (TLS enforced by default; unverified certs only accepted after an explicit user "Ignore" click per-error, cached as exceptions) | none | none (no hash/signature check before file is renamed into place as `libhamlib-4.dll`) | none | `Configuration.cpp:3855` `on_hamlib_download_button_clicked` builds URLs `https://hamlib.sourceforge.net/snapshots-4.7/dll32/libhamlib-4.dll` / `dll64/...` (`Configuration.cpp:3875,3880`); `Configuration.cpp:3905` `after_hamlib_downloaded()` renames `libhamlib-4_new.dll`→`libhamlib-4.dll` with **no hash/signature check**; `Network/FileDownload.cpp` has no checksum logic; `Network/NetworkAccessManager.cpp:18-51` `filter_SSL_errors()` shows TLS is enforced by default, exceptions only added after a modal "Network SSL/TLS Errors" dialog is accepted by the user. No app-version self-update check exists anywhere in the source (`main.cpp`, `widgets/mainwindow.cpp` searched; no match for "new version"/"check for update" logic beyond this hamlib-DLL swap feature and the splash-screen versioning comment at `main.cpp:293`, which is unrelated). |
